붕해시험 제1액 120분 이상 · 제2액 60분 이내

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodAt least 100 million CFU per 900 mgEnteric hard capsule

Lacto BloomProbiotics · Gut health

Made by Huons EN · Enteric hard capsule · 2 capsules (900 mg) once a day

The labelled standard for this product is at least 100 million CFU per 900 mg, and the official directions are 2 capsules (900 mg) once a day — the labelled basis and the serving are both 900 mg. The weight of a single capsule is not stated in the official text, so this page does not calculate a per-capsule count. Probiotics are recognized by Korea's MFDS as an ingredient that may help promote lactic acid bacteria growth and suppress harmful bacteria, may help support smooth bowel movement, and may help support gut health.

Why this product

  • Labelled basis 900 mg = one serving = the daily amount
  • Enteric hard capsule — official disintegration test: 120 minutes or more in fluid 1, within 60 minutes in fluid 2
  • Once a day — two capsules
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Translucent brown capsule · Made by Huons EN

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 capsules (900 mg) per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Probiotic count At least 100,000,000 CFU per 900 mg
Appearance Translucent brown enteric hard capsule with pale brown contents
Disintegration Fluid 1: 120 min or more · Fluid 2: within 60 min
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24 months from manufacture
Storage Room temperature, away from heat, humidity and direct sunlight

Who it suits

  • Those who want to be done in one go each day
  • Those who prefer capsules
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a medical condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children and follow the stated daily intake · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur

  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합

drafts.en:
Health Functional Food10 billion CFU per capsule1 capsule 350 mg = labelled basis

Sensitive Jang CareProbiotics · Gut health

Made by Pulmuone Health & Living · Hard capsule (350 mg) · Once a day

The labelled basis of 350 mg and one capsule of 350 mg are the same — so the 10 billion CFU in one capsule is the daily amount. Probiotics are recognized by Korea's MFDS as an ingredient that may help promote lactic acid bacteria growth and suppress harmful bacteria, may help support smooth bowel movement, and may help support gut health.

Why this product

  • Labelled basis 350 mg = 1 capsule = daily serving — no calculation needed
  • 10 billion CFU of probiotics per capsule
  • Disintegration within 20 minutes — its MFDS notified standard
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Clear hard capsule with greyish-yellow powder · Made by Pulmuone Health & Living

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule (350 mg) per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Probiotic count At least 10,000,000,000 CFU per 350 mg
Appearance Clear hard capsule containing greyish-yellow powder
Disintegration Within 20 minutes
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 15 months
Storage Away from direct sunlight, heat and humidity

Who it suits

  • Those who want one capsule a day
  • Those who prefer a clear capsule
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a medical condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children and follow the stated daily intake · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur
